slides.headline: The Science Stories You Need Today
slides.subtitle: From space discoveries to new tech, here is your daily science update.

slides.headline: Ahsoka Season 2 Is Officially Coming
slides.explanation: The first trailer for season two shows massive space battles and more Anakin Skywalker. It is a big win for fans waiting to see how the story continues.

slides.headline: How Our Galaxy Grew Up
slides.explanation: New data from the Hubble telescope proves the Milky Way grew by eating smaller galaxies early on. It gives us a clearer picture of how our home galaxy formed.

slides.headline: The Day We Found Mars's Moon
slides.explanation: On this day in 1877, astronomer Asaph Hall spotted the Martian moon Phobos for the first time. It is a reminder of how much we have learned about our solar system.

slides.headline: Locust Brains Can Spot Toxins
slides.explanation: Researchers found that locust neurons can detect harmful forever chemicals in the environment. This finding could lead to new, portable sensors to keep our water safe.

slides.headline: Ocean Currents And Global Warming
slides.explanation: A major Atlantic current system acts like a thermostat for the entire planet. If it weakens, it could speed up global temperature increases.
